reviews.review: Worth one playthrough. The combat is lots of fun, so if that's the most important part for you in an RPG and you are coming from something like Fallout 4, you won't be disappointed.

The thing with Andromeda is that it lacks the insane cinematography of ME2, the emotional impact of ME3, and the grand scale of ME1. Gameplay is amazing, although I prefer the more tactical and grounded approach of ME1 (and the sequels) because I think that emphasizes more the level design and the pathos overall, and you can feel that the Mass Effect soul is still there in some of the missions, but it's super diluted in the Ubisoft-like open world. The protagonist is a bit flat (the new tone system, which replaced the old Paragon\ Renegade model, is not as impactful imho), and the game could use more enemy variation too.

Still a solid 7 (maybe even an 8) in my book.

This is like the first Mass Effect, but not good. Seriously, it's going backwards, worse in every possible way. UI is the worst part, but it also goes for the writing, the missions, the animations, even the physics, 
lots of guns all meh, and the progresion and leveling systems are a huge let down.
Also why is my shield so small even with a bunch of upgrades?
"But the graphics are nice !" If you can run them faster than 0.2 FPS yeah probably. Absolutely no optimization whatsoever. I have a "BIG" PC, and can't run it correctly for all that is holy.

You want to get up to date for the next big Mass Effect Announcement ? Watch a youtube recap about it, don't bother playing this game if you are a fan of the original trilogy.

PS: It will launch through the EA App, but it makes itself discreet.
